text:
maria: heads-up — i'm pushing the Ginkgo customer LoRA merge to staging now. quick smoke eval pack queued.
aj: sweet. are we doing int8 or int4 for this one?
maria: tried int8 first, observed 1.8% BLEU drop on the customer's dialogue test. switched to int4 (nf4) to test unit-cost; initial run looks ok but want coverage on numerics.
chen: @maria can you paste the eval diffs when they land? i'm worried about tokenization mismatches we saw with their custom tokenizer last time.
maria: yes — sending logs + config. eval-bot: smoke-pack-results (run id gk-2026-03-21-01): 100 examples, metric summary: BLEU delta -0.4%, ExactMatch delta -0.2%, num-hits (numeric list cases) drop -12%. full diff link: https://ci/reports/gk-123
sam: big drop on numeric lists — same symptom as cust-pegasus earlier. possibly special tokens or soft-tokenization diff.
aj: do we have a repro? small failing example?
maria: here's a failing pair: input: "List prices: 10, 20, 30" expected: "10; 20; 30" model-int8 produced: "ten; twenty; thirty" — spelled out. weird.
chen: that points to tokenizer mapping numbers -> words during merge quant path. can you dump token ids for the input?
maria: pasted token ids snippet: ```[101, 2345, 117, 23, 45, 102]``` (not real ids) — noticed a sentinel token <num> they use that our tokenizer maps differently.
sam: proposed hotpatch: add token_map override in the adapter merge so <num> maps to preserved numeric token, not word form. minimal config: ```token_map:
  "<cust_num>": "<num>"
```
aj: also add a KV-cache-friendly prefix option, their adapter adds a prefix prompt that breaks continuous batching.
maria: applied hotpatch branch ginkgo/num-token-hotfix, reran the 100-case smoke. deploy-bot: Deployment to staging succeeded — job gk-deploy-998, image: redwood/ginkgo-hotfix:sha256abc
eval-bot: rerun-results (gk-2026-03-21-02): numeric-list hit rate recovered +11%, BLEU delta now -0.1%, EM delta 0.0%. attaching short sample: input: "Prices: 4, 8" -> output: "4; 8" :thumbsup:
chen: nice. can we make the token_map change configurable per-customer so Dedicated/private installs aren't affected?
maria: yep plan is to gate under 'customer_overrides' and add unit tests. will open PR and link the canonical tokenizer mapping doc.
aj: follow-up: run the 1k-eval pack overnight with int4 + hotpatch to get stable numbers before prod rollout. schedule should be in CI.
maria: yep scheduled. will ping here with the 1k summary tomorrow. thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
